# Tax Viz Prototype Instructions

- Read `PROJECT_SCOPE.md` and the latest `PHASE_*_HANDOFF.md` before proposing or editing phase work.
- Work in one narrow, approved phase at a time.
- Inspect existing callable signatures, result types, and relevant tests before editing.
- Do not change completed tax formulas, engines, orchestrator interfaces, or state/federal boundaries unless the approved phase explicitly requires it.
- Keep tax logic separate from presentation logic.
- Do not add UI, charts, API, serialization, CLI, or federal-state integration unless explicitly approved.
- Edit only the files named in the task; report every changed file.
- Add focused tests and run the specified focused suite plus the full suite.
- Keep output concise: changed files, tests added, and validation results.
